tape_read.note: Robust reference 22.33 (-2.67%) vs prev close 22.94; after-hours 22.16 (-3.4%), pre-market range 21.90-23.05, so it touched lower and has recovered somewhat. Active tape (260 prints, 29 in the last 30 min, last 09:17, not stale). Market is weak (SPY -0.5%, IWM -0.9%), so the stock-specific move is only about -2%: far less than my -9% release read and the 13.7% implied move. The night's read of a guide cut on a crowded 23-27% short has been mild.

thesis_check.note: The panel shorted on the FY EBITDA arithmetic needing an ~11.5% Q4 margin; the company cut the FY EBITDA range and guided Q4 to 8-10%, a third cut in 2026. Revenue was in line, gross margin fell further to 57%.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market, so the open should hold most of the -2.7%; the gap is under 3%, so a fade by 10:00 is only slightly more likely than not, and the crowded short can squeeze. My release read says more downside is justified than the pre-market shows, which tilts the session slightly lower, but the overnight read has already been mild.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers bevestigen de short: de winstverwachting voor heel 2026 is opnieuw verlaagd. Toch daalt het aandeel voorbeurs maar zo'n 2,7%, deels omdat de hele markt lager staat, en met zoveel shortposities kan het na de opening ook terugveren. Zonder nieuws dat meer daling aankondigt houden we de standaardregel aan: dekken bij de opening en de winst van ongeveer 3% meenemen.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de koers vóór 09:30 wegzakt onder de voorbeurslaag van 21,90 of als analisten hun koersdoel verlagen, dan pas wordt vasthouden tot het slot (exit_close) het overwegen waard.
